assistant|lentil_bolognese_recipe: Provided a lentil bolognese recipe: 4-6 servings, 30-40 minutes cooking time

Recipe ingredients: 1 cup dried green/brown lentils, 1 onion, 2 cloves garlic, 2 cups mixed mushrooms, 1 carrot, 1 celery stalk, 28 oz crushed tomatoes, dried basil and oregano, salt, pepper, optional 1/4 cup red wine
Recipe method: saute onion/garlic/carrot/celery 5-7 min, add mushrooms 5 min, add lentils and spices 1-2 min, add tomatoes and wine, simmer covered 20-25 min until lentils are tender
Recipe variations: mix lentil types, add bay leaves/thyme/rosemary, add tomato paste for richness, vary mushrooms, or add bell peppers/zucchini in last 10 minutes
assistant|side_dish_suggestion: Suggested roasted vegetable sides: broccoli with garlic and lemon, Brussels sprouts with balsamic and nuts, sweet potato wedges with rosemary, carrots with cumin and coriander, asparagus with Parmesan and lemon zest
Suggested sauteed greens: spinach with garlic and lemon, kale with cherry tomatoes and balsamic, collard greens with onions and smoked paprika
Suggested crunchy add-ins: toasted pumpkin seeds, chopped parsley or cilantro, crushed red pepper flakes, sliced almonds/walnuts/pecans
Suggested cheesy add-ins: shaved Parmesan, crumbly feta, grated mozzarella or ricotta
Suggested other add-ins: bell peppers, fresh basil/oregano/thyme, artichoke hearts, avocado
assistant|meal_prep_tip: Advised roasting a batch of vegetables on the weekend and storing in the fridge for up to 5 days
Advised cooking a large batch of quinoa and portioning it out for the week
Advised making a double batch of lentil bolognese and freezing it for up to 3 months, then thawing and reheating
assistant|sweet_potato_seasoning_suggest: Classic Herbs: olive oil, salt, pepper, chopped fresh rosemary/thyme/sage, or dried oregano/basil/parsley
Spicy Kick: olive oil, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, optional cayenne or red pepper flakes
Mediterranean Style: olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, dried oregano, optional kalamata olives or artichoke hearts
Sweet and Smoky: olive oil, brown sugar, smoked paprika, pinch of cayenne, optional chopped bacon or diced onions
Indian-Inspired: olive oil, garam masala, cumin, coriander, optional chopped cilantro or scallions
Lemon Rosemary: olive oil, lemon zest, minced garlic, chopped fresh rosemary, plus fresh lemon juice before serving
Simple Salt and Pepper: olive oil, salt and pepper as a straightforward option
assistant|roasted_sweet_potato_recipe: Provided roasted sweet potatoes with fresh rosemary recipe: 2-3 sweet potatoes peeled and cubed, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp chopped fresh rosemary, salt and pepper
Recipe method: oven at 425F (220C), toss cubes with oil/rosemary/salt/pepper, roast 20-25 minutes flipping halfway, until tender and caramelized
assistant|granola_customization_suggesti: Sweetness level: reduce or omit honey/maple syrup for less sweet granola, or drizzle it on after cooling for sweeter snack
Spices and flavorings: cinnamon, nutmeg, cardamom, vanilla extract, or cocoa powder for a chocolatey twist
Nuts and seeds: almonds, cashews, hazelnuts; chia, flax, or hemp seeds; peanut butter for creaminess
Dried fruits: cranberries, raisins, cherries, apricots, apples, pineapple; or omit dried fruits for a nutty crunchy granola
Grain options: rolled oats, quinoa, Kamut, puffed rice or wheat for lighter crunch
Other mix-ins: coconut flakes, dark chocolate chips or M&M's, cereal pieces like Cheerios or Cinnamon Toast Crunch
